description: The ☰ menu items that do something small instead of opening a view of their own, with the one confirmation dialog and the toasts that go with them: Copy Transcript for an Issue, Restart Baude, Restart Daemon, Read-only session, Open in Record…, and the Restart Now confirmation. These are dialogs/toasts/actions, grouped in one file as none is a dialog of its own (Settings, Changelog, Mesh, Send Feedback, Ongoing Feedback each have their own file; Kubernetes, Database Schemas and the menu itself are elsewhere).

parts.name: Copy Transcript for an Issue
parts.shows: Menu item "Copy Transcript for an Issue" (Record has it too). Puts text on the clipboard and shows a toast "Transcript copied" (2 s). The text: a header of lines "App: Baude", "Session: <id or new>", "Model: <the model claude says it started with>", "Picked: <model>" (only when it differs), "Effort: <effort or default>", "Mode: <permission mode>", "Host: <this machine, or name (host)>", "Folder: <cwd>", "Claude Code: <version>", "Context: <what the context meter shows, with its tooltip's detail, or 'not said yet'>", "Tools: <names>", "Copied: <date time zone>"; then the whole transcript in order, each entry headed "## User · <time>" / "## Claude (<model>) · <time>" / "## Tool results", each tool call with its whole input (JSON), each result marked result or error, each cut at 4000 characters, compactions as their own "## Conversation compacted" headings with the summary under them. For a chat on another host the mirror drawn here is used.

actions.does: copies the report; if there is no transcript yet, copies "(nothing said yet)" and a newline

parts.name: Restart Baude
parts.shows: Menu item "Restart Baude" (Record's: "Restart Record"), just above Restart Daemon. No confirmation.

phone.why: Re-executes the desktop process and puts back its windows; the phone's app restarts by the system.

actions.does: every window of the app is replaced by a fresh process that puts each back as it was (chat, scroll place, drafts, open tabs, feedback draft), giving the front back to the app you were in; chats of this machine's host process go on through it; a chat running as the app's own claude has its turn cut short and resumed after ("Cut short by a restart", with Continue). Nothing is said after a plain restart; after an automatic update a toast "Baude updated: N new commit(s)" (5 s) appears.

parts.name: Restart Daemon
parts.shows: Menu item "Restart Daemon" (Record has it too), the last item, under Restart Baude. No confirmation. The banner's Restart Daemon button does the same.

phone.why: The phone's host runs inside the app, on the app's own code, so there is no separate daemon to restart.

actions.does: asks this machine's host process to stop and start again once no command is running on it (it answers busy while one is; asked again every 5 s). A model turn going on is cut short ("Cut short by a restart", with Continue). Its chats are kept and resume as they're next written to. Toast "Restarting the daemon once N sessions finish running a command" while it waits, "Daemon restarted" once the new one is there. With no host process running, one is started.

parts.name: Restart Now confirmation
parts.shows: The sidebar's Update button, when a new version waits and things are running, first asks: heading "Restart now?", body "The new version is picked up now. These are stopped, and their chats can be continued after:" then a bulleted list of what would be stopped (running commands, a side question's reply being written, a dialog open, "you, using this window"), buttons Cancel and "Restart Now" (red). With nothing running it restarts at once without asking. (The button itself belongs to the sidebar.)
text: The new version is picked up now. These are stopped, and their chats can be continued after:

actions.does: asks this machine's host process to restart onto the update, then restarts the app

parts.name: Read-only session
parts.shows: A checkable menu item "Read-only session" (a check mark when on; Baude only). On: the chat has no text box at all (not a greyed one, and the attach row goes with it) — for a chat you only watch; the status line with the context it uses stays. Remembered per session id once the session has one, and applied again whenever that session is opened. A session another program has live is read-only too, while it does, without the item being on (and the text box is likewise gone); focus leaves the input to the chat when it hides.

actions.does: toggles: hides or shows the composer, and keeps the choice for this session

parts.name: Open in Record…
parts.shows: Menu item "Open in Record…" (Baude only). Starts Record, the notebook app, beside Baude, reading this chat on its Read tab in whichever notebook is open; a Record already running is handed the chat. With no transcript file yet it opens Record alone. No dialog or toast.

phone.why: Starts another desktop program from this one.

actions.does: launches record.py (detached) with --chat <this chat's transcript> when it exists

parts.name: Chat zoom toast
parts.shows: While the chat's zoom changes (Ctrl/Cmd +, -, 0 or the pinch/scroll gesture): a 1-second toast "Chat zoom <factor>" (for example 1.2), updated in place during a burst rather than stacked, shown once the zoom has settled.

states.name: read-only on
states.shows: No text box; the ☰ item checked

states.name: no transcript yet
states.shows: Copy Transcript copies only "(nothing said yet)"
